title: Libraries Looked Emptier As Digital Borrowing Hit 739 Million
hook: Libraries looked emptier while digital checkouts reached 739 million.
closing: Libraries did not lose readers; they became reachable wherever readers carry a phone.
question: How do you borrow library books?

segments.say: Library visits fell to 671 million. The building got quieter, but demand for books did not.
Since 2019, digital checkouts more than doubled to 739 million. Borrowing simply moved into an app.
